column1: # codebook: C1=summary drops or garbles a requirement (spec loss); C2=summary describes a different but coherent task (semantic drift); C3=summary is faithful, the code does not implement it; C4=signature/anchor failure: wrong name, arity or parameter semantics; C5=extraction or formatting failure (no code block, prose as code, truncation); C6=oracle dependence: survived longer under assert, and the failing code is wrong on the leaked example input; C7=plus-only failure: base tests pass, extended EvalPlus tests do not; C8=harness or other (timeout, exception, unparseable)
